rows.role_title: President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: Minutes items 29-45: after business resumed at 14:03 the Chief Justice took the Chair under section 86(2). The secret ballot began at 14:30. At 16:00 he announced Dandala 47 and Zuma 277, and Zuma was elected President of the Republic. The President-elect addressed the House from 16:05, and the House adjourned at 17:05. Signed by M B Coetzee, Acting Secretary to Parliament and Returning Officer.

bounded_scope: Head-of-state observations for CLAUDE-C01-09 only. Election, oath, inauguration, resignation announcement, resignation effect and acting service stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. Deputy presidents, ministers and party offices are excluded.
